quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 production capacity at the Hwaseong head office: 704 gas scrubbers and 1,920 chillers (based on 45 and 27 build hours per unit); actual H1 production 397 scrubbers and 1,319 chillers (full-year 2025: 476 and 2,029). quarterly_data.signal: Management (business overview): the company has entered a new overseas customer and HBM production lines; memory makers are drawing up mid- to long-term investment plans to meet a demand-supply shortage driven by AI data-center investment and a sharp rise in memory prices; the company will prepare for next-generation process transitions through eco-friendly equipment and advanced cooling technology.

R&D spend KRW 5,370,592 thousand in H1 2026 (3.47% of revenue). Development projects listed: a -100 degree C deep cryogenic chiller (two-stage refrigeration cycle; the company cites possible expansion into cryogenic etch equipment), a -80 degree C cryogenic chiller, an eco-friendly CO2 chiller (GWP 1 or below), a next-generation hybrid/electric chiller switching -20 to 170 degrees C within 2 minutes, a low-power plasma-torch scrubber (minimum 2kW, 35% power saving) and a low-power heat-wet scrubber (30% energy saving).
